title: A new community chat app joins the directory
summary:
A new community chat app joined the directory, and an existing listing got a better address.

PrivatePollenAI joined the project directory and LLM Integrations list. It stores chat data locally, uses Pollinations for text and image generation, and lets users choose a model and set custom system instructions. The urSapere AI listing also got an updated website link and creator attribution.
